title: phillyrea variabilis var. angustifolia
intro: Phillyrea variabilis var. angustifolia, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Mock Privet, is a plant species within the Oleaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which offer a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Narrow-leaved Mock Privet include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and acting as a diuretic, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily comprised of flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
